chunks: From him, from his father, from ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from Isḥaq ibn ʿAmmar, from Abi Baṣir, from Abi ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, concerning a woman who sees yellowish discharge.
He said: “If it is two days before menstruation, then it is part of menstruation; and if it is two days after menstruation, then it is not part of menstruation.”

key_terms.الْحَيْضِ: menstruation; the legally recognized menstrual state
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman under discussion in the ruling
key_terms.بِيَوْمَيْنِ: by two days; a period of two days used as the legal measure

ai.seo_question: When is yellowish discharge considered part of menstruation in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about yellowish discharge in relation to menstruation. If it appears two days before the onset of menstruation, it is treated as menstrual blood; if it appears two days after menstruation, it is not treated as menstruation.
